data.name: Masterstone
data.detailed_description:
Masterstone is an old-school action RPG with roguelite elements, built around challenge and replayability. Every run is unique. Levels, enemies, loot, abilities, and even parts of the story are procedurally generated, so no two playthroughs are ever the same. Runs are focused and self-contained, typically lasting a few hours and often ending in death.

Randomly dropped skills and loot force improvised builds, keeping each run fresh. Combat is deliberate and dangerous. Every enemy is a threat, resources are limited, and death is punishing and can be game-ending. Long-term progression unlocks new classes, giving you new ways to tackle future runs. Play solo or team up with friends in multiplayer co-op.

Features

Procedurally Generated Worlds and Story

Levels, enemy encounters, and even parts of the story change with each playthrough, keeping exploration unpredictable.

Improvised Character Development

Character abilities are discovered during play, forcing you to adapt new builds for every run.

Deliberate, Old-School Combat

Combat is methodical and dangerous. Every enemy can be lethal, and careless play is punished.

Over 100 Abilities to Discover

A wide variety of abilities encourages experimentation and creates countless possible builds. Each run gives new opportunities to combine skills and items in creative ways.

Massive Loot and Item Variety

Items come with a wide range of modifiers, creating synergies and unexpected combinations that make each run feel different.

Semi-Hardcore

Death has real consequences, crippling your character and is ultimately game-ending if repeated.

Persistent Progression

Unlock new classes by discovering their abilities, giving you a headstart with a specific skillset at the beginning of each run.

Multiplayer Co-op

Team up with friends to tackle challenges together. Difficulty scales naturally with the number of players, keeping the experience tense and rewarding.
